fusions.name: Nine Hundred Pounds
fusions.desc: Throws all your mass into one blow for 34 damage that ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Clearing Sweep
fusions.desc: Swats at every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage.

fusions.name: Unshaken Hulk
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Doubled Mass
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your armour rises by 5%, from silver your health regenerates 12% faster, and from gold you attack 5% faster.
